body:
Quick mode — no voting panel. Rounds 1-3: 5 Cursor specialists in parallel + generic Codex. Main agent reviewed findings across 1 round.

Round 1: 4/6 reviewers OK (structure: OK, correctness: OK, testing: OK, security: NOT_SUBSTANTIVE, edge-cases: NOT_SUBSTANTIVE, codex-generic: OK).

Accepted (2, implemented inline):
- Case-insensitive Implementation Plan header dedup (correctness, testing, codex reviewers)
- Add Test strategy + Verification strategy test fixtures (testing reviewer)

Rejected (4):
- Exit on next heading is correct markdown behavior (not a bash comment issue)
- Sections after test plan are dropped by design (pre-existing behavior)
- /fix-issue SKILL.md findings: out of scope for this PR
- Branch scope finding: larch-log chore commits are pre-existing on branch
